newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE HAT-TRICK SPEARHEADS RANGERS TO 5-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE HAT-TRICK SPEARHEADS RANGERS TO 5-0 WIN.

text.p: Paul Gascoigne delivered a personal message to England manager Glenn Hoddle on Saturday with a stunning second-half hat-trick as Rangers beat Motherwell 5-0 to stay top of the Scottish premier division.

Gascoigne's place in the England team for their next World Cup match against Georgia is in doubt following problems in his personal life and his less than inspiring display against Poland earlier this month, but he shone in the second half with goals after 66, 79 and 84 minutes.
Danish international Brian Laudrup opened the scoring with a superb 20-metre shot after 51 minutes and added another after 78 minutes.

Gascoigne, who had been booked a minute earlier, scrambled his first goal home to make it 2-0 after Laudrup had delivered the cross and Laudrup made it 3-0 when he squeezed the ball beyond goalkeeper Scott Howie after Gascoigne had turned provider.

Gascoigne made it 4-0 with 10 minutes to go when his stunning volley from Alex Cleland's cross left Howie stranded and he completed his hat-trick with another powerful finish following a fine cross from Cleland.

Celtic stayed two points behind Rangers at the top of the table after winning 4-0 at Hibernian thanks to two goals from German forward Andreas Thom, one from Dutchman Pierre Van Hooydonk and a fourth from Simon Donnelly.
